div.head: Quadr Ded 26
div.ab: Expectanda uidebatur saltem bone uoluntatis inpunitas! Exigere decreueram gratiarum actiones: et inuectiones redeunt! Ó inuectiones, ó homines, ó tempora in quibus omnia præposteris naturæ legibus euersa conspicimus!
div.note: New row (October 2026): Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 531 (two independent readings of the page images, differences settled against the page)
div.ab: At least impunity for good will seemed to be expected! I had resolved to demand thanks: and invectives come back! O invectives, O men, O times in which we see all things overturned, the laws of nature turned upside down!
